title: 第2554章 习法处理俘虏第2553章 大出血普天同庆
content_zh:
不消片刻。
跟在后面救援众人，浩浩荡荡来到密室门口。
推开门霎那。
从山洞禁地带出刑天战鼓、《三十六驱邪符箓总卷》《化血魔刀》《大采补经》等法器、功法，悉数暴露于众人眼前。
看得他们大为吃惊。
这些宝贝有多好，进了主办方兜，基本没返场希望。
却托小鬼子的福，用这种方式重现他们眼前。
这么大福利砸头上。
砸的见惯好东西，拿到人屠剑姜乐瑶都按捺不住心神。
颤颤巍巍张口：“这.....这些东西也要分吗？”
咚！
给点颜色就开染坊，痴心妄想的话说出口。
被天大福利砸中姜乐瑶小脑袋，福利没吃到。
反挨主办方天锤轰击。
传出他喝骂：
“分你个头！”
“都拿这么多好东西给你们竞猜，还不满足。”
“给你们两天时间。”
“不管是撼天鼓还是《三十六驱邪符箓总卷》，《化血魔刀》还是《大采补经》，想学什么学什么，能学多少学多少。”
“都是你们本事。”

“两天之后，密室门关闭，所有人停止学习。”
“要进去的举手。”
什么！
两天的学习时间！
众人在山洞二层境地时，为对付化魔莉奥薇。
曾学过这些秘法。
却碍于时间有限，只学了个皮毛就匆忙上阵。
没学到精髓。
本以为和这些东西无缘，却太阳从西边出来。
望着那实力非凡撼天七鼓、《三十六驱邪符箓总卷》。
满腔欢喜张口举手：
“我！”
“我！”
“我要进去！”
比分古董价值高的多，天大福利一分发，密室门口举起的手，跟拔地而出竹笋差不多。
疯狂往前挤门，
李向东第三重奖励分完，剩下的就交给他们。
让开密室入口放人进去。
短短一息不到。
堵在密室门口众人，就从十多个锐减到四个。

两个黑的两个白的。
黑的是悟苦大师、吴元奎，白的神里、水尾。
content_en:
It doesn't take a moment.
Followed behind to rescue everyone, and arrived at the door of the secret room.
The moment I opened the door.
The Xingtian War Drum, the "Thirty-six Exorcist Talisman Volume", the "Blood-Transforming Demonic Knife" and the "Great Picking and Tonic Sutra" were brought out from the forbidden area of ​​the cave, and all of them were exposed to the public.
They were greatly surprised.
No matter how good these babies are, they are in the organizer's pocket and there is basically no hope of returning.
But thanks to the little devil, he reappeared in front of them in this way.
Such a big benefit is a blow to the head.
He was used to smashing good things, and even Jiang Leyao couldn't hold back his nerves when he got the sword to kill people.
He opened his mouth tremblingly: "Are these things also going to be divided?"
Boom!
Just give me some color and open a dyeing workshop, and speak out my wishful thinking.
Jiang Leyao was hit in the head by a big welfare, but he didn't get the welfare.
The organizer counterattacked with a hammer blow.
It was reported that he was shouting and cursing:
"Divide your heads!"
"I've given you so many good things to compete with, and you're still not satisfied."
"I'll give you two days."
"Whether it's the Sky-Shaking Drum, the Thirty-Six Exorcist Talismans, the Blood-Transforming Demonic Knife, or the Dacai Bu Jing, you can learn whatever you want, and learn as much as you can."
"It's all your fault."
"Two days later, the secret room door was closed and everyone stopped studying."
"Raise your hands if you want to go in."
What!
Two days of study!
When everyone was on the second floor of the cave, they were trying to deal with the demon Leovie.
I have learned these secret techniques.
However, due to limited time, I only learned a superficial lesson and rushed into battle.
Didn't learn the essence.
I thought I had nothing to do with these things, but the sun came out from the west.
Looking at the extraordinary powerful seven drums that shook the sky, "Thirty-Six Evil Exorcism Talismans".
Full of joy, he opened his mouth and raised his hands:
"Me!"
"Me!"
"I want to go in!"
The value is much higher than that of antiques. Once the great benefits are distributed, the hands raised at the door of the secret room are like bamboo shoots sprouting from the ground.
Pushing forward like crazy for the door,
Li Xiangdong finished distributing the third level of rewards, and left the rest to them.
Let the entrance to the secret room open and let people in.
In less than a breath.
The number of people blocking the door of the secret room dropped sharply from more than ten to four.
Two black and two white.
The black ones are Master Wu Ku and Wu Yuankui, and the white ones are Shenli and Shuiwei.
